categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches src/wallet/dump.cpp and bears the Wallet label, modifying bitcoin-wallet dump error handling.
categories.rationale: Prevents silent failure where bitcoin-wallet dump could return success and leave behind a truncated backup if writes failed or disk space ran out. As noted in the PR description, DumpWallet previously 'only checked whether the dump file could be opened' and could exit with success despite incomplete writes, posing a severe backup correctness and key-loss risk if a user relies on the incomplete dump.
